annotations.title: Screen a non-U.S. life insurance policy under IRC §7702

description: Preliminary screen of whether a non-U.S. savings-type life insurance policy (for example a Hong Kong whole-life or savings plan) meets the U.S. definition of life insurance under IRC §7702, using the cash value accumulation test (CVAT) and the cash value corridor, from the policy's cash value table. A policy that fails is taxed each year on its inside growth (§7702(g)). Values in any one currency (ratios do not depend on currency). Does not check the guideline premium limit.

increasing_benefit_rule.description: For policies whose death benefit grows by a fixed rate: lets years without a death_benefit be computed.

growth_rate.description: Yearly growth of the sum insured as a decimal (0.035 = 3.5%).

issue_age.description: Insured's age at issue, completed years.

issue_year.description: Calendar year the policy was issued.

policy_years.description: Rows from the policy's illustration / cash value table; a few years such as 1, 5, 10, 20 are enough.

cash_value.description: Cash (surrender) value at the end of that policy year.

death_benefit.description: Death benefit at the end of that policy year (omit only when increasing_benefit_rule is given).
